items.exampleEn: Do you want cream in your coffee?
items.exampleZh: 你的咖啡要加鮮奶油嗎？

items.exampleEn: I like cheese on my pizza.
I have bread and milk for breakfast.
Please use a knife to cut the bread.

items.sentenceEn: I have bread and cheese for lunch.

items.audioEn: I don't drink coffee. Can I have some tea with milk?
items.audioZh: 我不喝咖啡，可以給我一些加牛奶的茶嗎？

items.stemEn: I cut the bread with a ____.
Would you like ____ or sugar in your coffee?
items.stemZh: 你的咖啡要加鮮奶油還是糖？

items.passageEn: Every Sunday morning, my family has a big breakfast. My mother makes bread, and my father cooks potatoes and eggs. We put butter and cheese on the bread. My parents drink tea, and my brother and I drink milk.
items.passageZh: 每個星期天早上，我們家都會吃一頓豐盛的早餐。我媽媽做麵包，我爸爸煮馬鈴薯和蛋。我們在麵包上塗奶油、放起司。我爸媽喝茶，我和我的兄弟喝牛奶。

referenceEn: I drink a glass of milk in the morning.
I have a cup of milk every morning.
rubricZh: 「一杯」可用 a glass of 或 a cup of
milk 是不可數名詞，不加 s
時間可寫 in the morning、every morning 等

referenceEn: The tea at this shop is very famous.
This shop is famous for its tea.
rubricZh: 「很有名」可寫，例如 is very famous、is famous for its tea 等
泛指茶時不加 a；「這家店」可寫，例如 this shop、this store 等
